from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Find the repeated tile pitch from all-zero separator bands.
    def bands(axis):
        n=h if axis==0 else w
        return [i for i in range(n) if all((grid[i][j] if axis==0 else grid[j][i])==0 for j in range(w if axis==0 else h))]
    rs,cs=bands(0),bands(1)
    def pitch(vals):
        ds=[b-a for a,b in zip(vals,vals[1:]) if b-a>1]
        return Counter(ds).most_common(1)[0][0] if ds else None
    pr,pc=pitch(rs),pitch(cs)
    if pr is None or pc is None:return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=next((r for r in range(pr) if any(grid[r])),0)
    c0=next((c for c in range(pc) if any(grid[i][c] for i in range(h))),0)
    cr=(pr-1)//2; cc=(pc-1)//2
    centers=[]
    for r in range(r0+cr,h,pr):
        for c in range(c0+cc,w,pc):
            if grid[r][c]!=0: centers.append((r,c,grid[r][c]))
    counts=Counter(v for _,_,v in centers)
    if len(counts)<2:return [row[:] for row in grid]
    common=counts.most_common(1)[0][1]

            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc2<w and grid[rr][cc2]==0:

                rr+=dr;cc2+=dc

    # Find 3x3 monochrome tile centers on the 7-cell lattice. The less frequent

                v=grid[r][c]
                if v not in (0,4) and all(grid[r+i][c+j]==v for i in range(3) for j in range(3)):
                    centers.append((r+1,c+1,v))
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for _,_,v in centers)
    if not counts:return out
    top=max(counts.values())
    markers={v for v,n in counts.items() if n<top}
    for r,c,v in centers:
        if v not in markers: continue
        for dr,dc in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):

            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
